params.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT TRY_CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) AS v FROM data) SELECT COUNT(*) AS responses, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v >= 9) AS promoters, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v <= 6) AS detractors, ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v >= 9) - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v <= 6)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS nps FROM s WHERE v BETWEEN 0 AND 10

params.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS responses, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promoters, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detractors, CAST(ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS BIGINT) AS nps FROM data WHERE "推奨度" IS NOT NULL
